bug_fix_verified.issue: User reported 'Failed to save' and 'Failed to update' errors when toggling generation permissions and saving brain in admin Agents tab
bug_fix_verified.root_cause: credentials:'include' in fetch calls caused CORS issues. When credentials mode is 'include', browser requires specific CORS headers that K8s proxy may not provide
bug_fix_verified.fix_applied: Removed credentials:'include' from ALL frontend fetch calls. JWT auth via Authorization header doesn't need cookies.
bug_fix_verified.verification: All admin toggles, brain editor save, and tab saves now work without CORS errors
